name: Liqvd Digital India Limited
about: Liqvd Digital India Limited engages in the digital marketing business in India. It offers online reputation management and digital PR, performance marketing and data-driven campaigns, search engine marketing and optimization services for mobile and social media, influencer marketing solutions, media planning and buying services for brand communications, social media management, and branded content services; and develops digital experiences for brands. The company also provides reality, social media marketing, mobile marketing, and localised services; creative solutions for commission/retainer based commercial arrangements; and conducts research on ground and online consumer interactions for data collection. In addition, it is also involved in the creation, delivery, and certification of digital and other marketing training courses; provision of internet marketing and web services; and e-commerce web, software, and mobile development activities. The company serves large enterprises, mid-sized brands, and direct-to consumer startups. Liqvd Digital India Limited was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Mumbai, India.
